book.title: Sybil: The Classic True Story of a Woman Possessed by Sixteen Personalities
book.description:
Here is the unbelievable yet true story of Sybil Dorsett, a survivor of terrible childhood abuse who as an adult was a victim of sudden, mysterious blackouts. What happened during those blackouts has made Sybil's experience one of the most famous psychological cases in the world.
